response: The principle of Information refers to the requirement that when generative AI is used in schools or any education purpose, all users are provided with easy-to-understand information about the tool, including any risks, and why it is being used. This disclosure is important for accountability of school systems, so people know how their data is being used and can contest its use or outputs.
